This film just demonstrates, yes, how queer these films really are. Yes, we have a female baseball player in these scenes. The film shows her catching ball, and warming up, and then we get a slow motion shot of her at bat, but she STRIKES OUT. WHAT? What was the point of that? Then she DOES get a hit, but then the first baseman tags her out. Then we see THAT in sloe motion. Stupid woman, doing a man's sport! Look where that got you!
But still the steel giant of today!
